item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A humid maritime airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be windier over the coast of southeastern China on Saturday. A trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China early next week. Meanwhile, the northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather to the region. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. The weather will become cold progressively and there will be a few rain patches over the region.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Foggy with one or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Sunny periods during the day.
